name: Prevent Healing
description: Prevents the entity from healing via natural means (like the "minecraft:natural_health_regeneration" game rule) or further means.

fields.description: If true, healing from things like potion effects will also be prevented.

name: Dummy
description: A dummy ability that does nothing.

name: Carry
description: While enabled, pressing the ability's key grabs the first living entity hit by a forward raycast, holding it until the key is pressed again (drop) or, if throwable, the player right-clicks (throw).

fields.description: How far forward the grab raycast reaches.
How many blocks in front of the player the carried target is held. Defaults to 2.0.
Extra vertical offset applied to the carried target's held position. Defaults to 0.0.
If true, right-clicking while carrying throws the target instead of requiring the key to drop it. Defaults to false.
Velocity applied to the target when thrown, in the player's look direction. Only relevant if throwable is true. Defaults to 1.5.

name: Shrink Body Overlay
description: An ability that shrinks the body overlay of the entity.

name: Blast
description: Shoots a piece of a beam into the direction the player is looking at. The blast keeps the direction it was fired in and only deals damage once it reached its target.

fields.description: The id of the beam renderer to use
The damage the blast deals to entities
The damage type used when an entity is hit. If not set, it counts as a normal player or mob attack.
The maximum distance the blast can travel
The blocks the blast travels per tick
The length of the blast in blocks
The amount of ticks the hit entity is set on fire
If the blast should cause fire on blocks
If the blast should smelt hit blocks

name: Projectile
description: Shoots a projectile entity

fields.description: ID of an entity type (must be a projectile).
Additional NBT data for the projectile entity.
Inaccurary when shooting the projectile
Velocity with which the projectile is being shot
The arm which will swing when the projectile is being shot
Usually, the current velocity of player will be added to the projectile's velocity. This setting can disable that.
A [x, y, z] spawn offset, relative to the entity's facing direction. Defaults to [0, 0, 0].

name: Area Action
description: An ability that can perform one or many action objects on living entities within a certain range.

fields.description: Action(s) that are performed during the first tick of the ability
Action(s) that are performed during each tick of the ability
Action(s) that are performed during the last tick of the ability

Condition(s) that must be met for an entity to be affected by the ability. If no conditions are specified, then all entities will be affected. If multiple conditions are specified, then only entities that satisfy all conditions will be affected.
The area around the player that entities are looked for.
Decides if the player executing should also be effected.

name: Grapple
description: Fires a grappling hook that flies out to a range and latches on contact: reels a hit living entity toward the caster, or reels the caster toward a hit block.

fields.description: The maximum distance the grapple can reach.
If true, the hook latches onto a living entity it flies into and reels it toward the caster.
If true, the hook latches onto a block it flies into and reels the caster toward it.
The velocity, in blocks/tick, that the pulled entity (or the caster) is reeled at.
The velocity, in blocks/tick, that the hook itself flies out at.
"held" keeps the grapple active only while the ability is enabled (released on disable); "one_shot" fires once and runs to completion on its own.
The id of the beam renderer used to draw the rope, e.g. one used by the swinging flight type or your own under assets/<namespace>/palladium/beams/.
Sound played once when the grapple is fired.
Looping sound played while the grapple is actively reeling.
Sound played once when the grapple detaches (arrives, times out, or is released mid-pull).

name: Wall Climbing
description: Allows the player to climb up walls.

name: Invisibility
description: Makes the player invisible. Also makes mobs not see the player anymore.

fields.description: The opacity the player will adapt
The opacity at which the player will see themself. If this is being set to something less than 0 it will use the default opacity setting.
A multiplier for how visible the player is to mobs. 0.0 means completely invisible, 1.0 means normal visibility.

name: palladium.ability.palladium.forced_perspective
description: Locks the camera of the player into a perspective while enabled. The perspective the player had before is restored afterwards.

fields.description: The perspective the camera is locked into.

name: Multi Jump
description: While enabled, lets the entity jump again in mid-air up to a set number of times before it needs to touch the ground again to refill its extra jumps. Fall damage is only taken for the distance fallen below the position of the last extra jump.

fields.description: How many extra mid-air jumps the entity can perform before landing again.
The vertical velocity applied per extra jump. Defaults to the same strength as a normal jump.
The horizontal velocity added in the direction the entity is facing per extra jump.
Sound played whenever an extra jump is performed.

name: Push
description: When activated, applies a one-time velocity impulse to every living entity within range - either vertically (positive amount pushes up, negative pulls down) or horizontally, away from or toward the user's location (positive pushes away, negative pulls toward).

fields.description: How far from the entity other living entities can be to be affected.
Whether to push vertically (up/down) or horizontally (away from/toward the user).
The velocity applied. For vertical: positive is up, negative is down. For horizontal: positive pushes targets away from the user, negative pulls them toward the user.

name: Hide Body Part
description: Hides the specified body parts of the entity.

fields.description: The body parts to hide.
Determines if the first person arm should disappear as well (if it's disabled).

name: Shader Effect
description: Applies a shader effect to the player.

fields.description: The ID of the shader that shall be applied.

name: Combo Attack
description: Tracks consecutive melee attacks and deals bonus damage on the final hit of the combo. Missing a swing or hitting a block resets the combo.

fields.description: The number of consecutive attacks needed to trigger the final, bonus-damage attack.
Flat damage added to the final attack of the combo.
The amount of time, in ticks, the entity can go without attacking before the combo counter resets.
Action(s) run when the final attack of the combo lands.

name: Slowfall
description: Makes the entity fall slower.

name: Screen Shake
description: Shakes the camera of the player who has the ability while it is enabled. The strength follows the ability's animation timer, so setting an "animation_timer" in the properties makes the shake fade in and out smoothly. Without one, the shake starts and stops instantly.

fields.description: How far the camera moves, in degrees. A single number shakes yaw and pitch by that amount, an object sets yaw, pitch and roll separately.
How many shake cycles happen per tick. Higher values shake faster. Can be a dynamic value, the shake then speeds up or slows down smoothly.

name: Skin Change
description: An ability that changes the player's skin.

fields.description: The texture that should be used for the player's skin.
Model type for the player. If left empty it will keep the player's model type. 'wide' = Wide-armed Steve model; 'slim' = Slim-armed Alex model;
Priority for the skin (in case multiple skin changes are applied, the one with the highest priority will be used)

name: Flight
description: Allows the player to fly using a pre-defined flight type

fields.description: The ID of the flight type that will be used.
Multiplier applied to the speeds defined in the flight type.

name: Command
description: An ability that executes commands.

fields.description: The commands that are executed during each tick of the ability being active.
The commands that are executed upon activating the ability.
The commands that are executed on the last tick of the ability being active.

name: Fluid Walking
description: Allows the entity to walk on a specific fluid.

fields.description: The fluid tag(s) the entity can walk on.

name: Intangibility
description: Makes the entity intangible to certain blocks.

fields.description: Makes the player vertically intangible aswell.
Block tag which includes the block the player can phase through. Leave null for all blocks.
Block tag which includes the block the player can phase through. Leave null for all blocks.

name: Damage Immunity
description: Makes the entity immune against certain damage types.

fields.description: The damage types the entity is immune against.

name: Sound
description: Plays a sound.

fields.description: The sound that is being played.
The volume for the played sound.
The pitch for the played sound.
Whether or not the sound should loop during the time the ability is enabled.
Whether or not the sound should be played to just the player executing the ability, or to all players.

name: Prevent Gliding
description: Prevents & stops the player from gliding with an elytra.

name: Gliding
description: Allows the player to use the elytra gliding

name: Gui Overlay
description: Renders an image on the screen.

fields.description: The texture to render.
The width of the texture.
The height of the texture.
The translation of the texture.
The rotation of the texture.
The scale of the texture.
Determines how the image is aligned on the screen.
If enabled, the image is hidden together with the rest of the GUI when pressing F1. Disable it for images that should always stay visible, like the inside of a helmet.

name: Prevent Sprinting
description: Prevents the player from sprinting.

name: Show Both Arms
description: Enables the rendering of your off-hand in first-person.

name: Beam
description: Shoots an beam in the direction the player is looking at.

fields.description: The id of the beam renderer to use
The damage the beam deals to entities
The damage type used when an entity is hit. If not set, it counts as a normal player or mob attack.
The maximum distance the beam can travel
The amount of ticks the hit entity is set on fire
If the beam should cause fire on blocks
If the beam should smelt hit blocks

name: Player Skin Change
description: An ability that changes the player's skin to the one of a Minecraft player one.

fields.description: The username of the player you want to turn into.
Priority for the skin (in case multiple skin changes are applied, the one with the highest priority will be used)

name: Attribute Modifier
description: Adds an attribute modifier to the entity while the ability is enabled.

fields.description: The attribute modifier(s) that will be applied

name: Mode Switch
description: Cycles through a map of modes each time it is activated, switching to the next one whose conditions are met and briefly showing it on screen.

fields.description: A map of mode key -> mode (at least one). Each mode has a required "title", an optional "icon" texture, and optional "conditions" (a mode is only switchable-to while its conditions are met). The key is the unique id used by the mode condition and value.

name: Aim
description: Allows the player to aim their arms.

fields.description: The arm(s) that should point.

name: Fire Aspect
description: Makes this entity's attacks light targets on fire as if fire aspect was used.

fields.description: The amount of time, in ticks, that the victim entity will be set on fire for
If true, attacking an entity that's already on fire will add the "time" field to their current burn time instead of setting it
If "should_stack_time" is true, the victim's burn time (in ticks) will not exceed this value after being hit

name: Prevent Effects
description: Prevents the entity from being able to gain OR only be able to gain the specified effects. Does NOT clear effects.

fields.description: If to be immune to all BUT the specified effects.
The effects that you will be immune to.

name: Action On Hit
description: Performs actions to a victim when the entity with the ability damages them.

fields.description: Action(s) that are performed when an entity is attacked

Condition(s) that must be met for an entity to be affected by the ability. If no conditions are specified, then all entities will be affected. If multiple conditions are specified, then only entities that satisfy all conditions will be affected.
If false, then projectiles and other non-direct damage will also trigger the Action(s).

name: Step Down
description: Allows for stepping down blocks quickly.

fields.description: Speed at which you fall off the block.
Fall distance it will enable at.
If false, checks for if the ability SHOULD be enabled such as the entity being in spectator, fall flying, swimming, or on the ground will be disabled.
If true, it will work for living vehicles.
If true, it will work in fluids.
The fluid the entity can walk down when in.

name: Geo Animation
description: This ability let's you trigger animations defined in a GeckoLib render layer.

fields.description: The ID of the render layer receiving the animation. Must be a gecko render layer!
Name of the animation controller the animation is played on.
Name of the animation trigger

name: Action
description: An ability that can perform one or many action objects.

fields.description: Action(s) that are performed during the first tick of the ability
Action(s) that are performed during each tick of the ability
Action(s) that are performed during the last tick of the ability

name: Entity Glow
description: Makes the entity itself glow, or lets you see other entities with their glow effect.

fields.description: Determines if this ability makes the entity itself glow ("self"), or lets you see other entities with their glow effect ("others").
Determines the color of the glow effect. If left empty, it will use the default team color.
The distance at which the glow effect is visible. If 0, it will behave normally.
A condition, evaluated on the client, that must be met for the glow to appear.

name: Healing
description: An ability that heals the entity every x ticks by y amount.

fields.description: The frequency of healing (in ticks)
The amount of hearts for each healing

name: Sculk Immunity
description: When enabled, the player will not cause any walk-related sculk vibrations anymore.

name: Guard
description: While enabled, blocks incoming damage until a threshold is reached, at which point the guard breaks: damage is dealt to the entity and a break effect plays.

fields.description: The cumulative damage the entity can absorb while guarding before the guard breaks.
The damage dealt to the entity when the guard breaks.
How long the guard stays broken after breaking. Using the palladium:guard_broken condition inside a not condition on this ability to enable this lockout.

The width, in degrees, of the arc in front of the entity's look direction that can block damage. 360 blocks from all directions, including damage without a source position (e.g. magic). Defaults to 180 (front hemisphere).
Damage types that go through the guard. Defaults to the #minecraft:bypasses_shield tag, which also covers fall, fire and void damage.
If true, the entity cannot attack entities or interact with items/blocks/entities while this ability is enabled. Only applies to players. Defaults to true.

How strongly the entity that directly hit the guarding entity is knocked away whenever a hit is blocked. Projectile shooters are not affected. 0 disables this. Defaults to 0.5 (roughly 1 block of push).
Sound played whenever a hit is blocked.
Sound played when the guard breaks.

name: Size
description: Changes the size of the entity while the ability is enabled, smoothly reverting when disabled.

fields.description: The target size multiplier (multiplicative with other active size modifiers). Clamped to the size change type's min/max size.
The size change type defining the transition duration and easing.

name: Particles
description: Spawns particles around the entity.

fields.description: List of emitter IDs where the particles spawn at.
ID of the particle you want to spawn.
Additional options for the particle (like color of a dust particle).

name: Name Change
description: Changes the name of the player executing the ability.

fields.description: The new name of the player.

name: Slide
description: While enabled, pressing crouch during a sprint launches the entity into a ground slide along its facing direction, knocking back any living entities it slides into.

fields.description: Horizontal blocks/tick the slide starts at.
How many ticks the slide lasts (speed decays linearly to 0 over this time).
Per-tick retention (0-1) of any pre-existing horizontal velocity blended into the slide. Defaults to 0.93.
Knockback strength applied to entities the slide sweeps into, in the slide's direction.
How far past the entity's own hitbox the knockback sweep reaches each tick. Defaults to 1.0.

name: Restrict Slots
description: Restricts the slots of the entity.

fields.description: The slots that should be restricted.

name: Dual Wielding
description: Lets you attack with the item in your off hand by right-clicking. The off hand has its own attack cooldown, and the attack only happens if right-clicking didn't already do something else, like placing a block or eating. While active, your empty off hand is also shown in first person.
